scope: Actual updateToolProposal/renderToolResult functions extracted from current index.html, rendered in a fresh real Chrome DOM with synthetic tool-result payloads.
limitations: Component rendering verification, not full production HTTP/WebSocket integration.
No real provider or website/search semantics; no browser tool is executed.
No production port 8026, service restart, private DB, keys, chats, audio, or GPU work.
